title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 11: Rehoboam is told not to fight Israel, fortifies Judah, receives the Levites and builds his family.

questions.text: How many chosen warriors did Rehoboam assemble from Judah and Benjamin to fight against Israel?
questions.explanation: He assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors.

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh's word come with a message for Rehoboam?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Shemaiah the man of God.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Rehoboam and the people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me."

answers.text: Not to go up or fight against their brothers
To attack Jeroboam at once with all his men
To make a treaty with the king of Egypt
To move the capital from Jerusalem to Hebron

questions.text: Which of these cities did Rehoboam build for defense in Judah?
questions.explanation: Among the cities he built for defense were Bethlehem, Etam and Tekoa.

questions.text: What did Rehoboam put in the strongholds besides captains?
questions.explanation: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil and wine.

answers.text: Statues of the kings of Judah
Stores of food, oil and wine

questions.text: Why did the Levites leave their pasture lands and come to Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, so that they should not execute the priest's office to Yahweh.

answers.text: Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off as priests
There was a great famine in the land of Israel
Rehoboam had paid them silver to come south
Their cities had been taken by the king of Egypt

questions.text: For what did Jeroboam appoint his own priests?
questions.explanation: He appointed priests for the high places, for the male goats and for the calves which he had made.

answers.text: For the temple of Yahweh in Jerusalem
For the army of Israel in the field
For the cities of refuge in the land
For the high places, the male goats and the calves

questions.text: For how long did the people walk in the way of David and Solomon and make Rehoboam strong?
questions.explanation: They made Rehoboam strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

questions.text: Which son of Maacah did Rehoboam appoint as chief among his brothers?
questions.explanation: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, because he intended to make him king.

questions.text: Which wife did Rehoboam love above all his wives and concubines?
questions.explanation: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines.
